_meta.description: Heart event #3 for npc_janis: The Overlook

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [Janis stands at The Overlook alone, her composure cracked]

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: I was just... assessing the view. For my report.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: ...That's a lie. I come here to think.

options.text: It's the best thinking spot in town.
You don't have to be 'on' all the time.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: In the Council cities, vulnerability is a tactical error.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: Here... people just ASK how you're doing. Without an agenda.
